# MedleyHR

> MedleyHR is a self-serve HR and payroll management platform for businesses worldwide, built with India-first compliance. It lets any company run payroll, manage leaves, track attendance, and stay compliant — without an implementation consultant or a months-long setup.

## What is MedleyHR?

MedleyHR is an HRMS (Human Resource Management System) operated by Codonsoft Technologies, Bengaluru, India. It is designed for businesses of all sizes — from 5-person startups to multi-branch enterprises — who want to own their HR operations without depending on consultants or spreadsheets.

The platform is fully self-serve: sign up, configure, and run your first payroll on the same day. Most teams complete setup in under a few hours.

## Key Capabilities

- **Payroll automation**: Calculate salaries, deductions, and net pay automatically. Supports custom salary components, arrears, and bonus processing.
- **India statutory compliance**: PF (Provident Fund), ESI, TDS, Professional Tax, and Form 16 — handled out of the box, updated automatically with regulatory changes.
- **Leave management**: Configure leave policies, track balances, and manage approval workflows.
- **Attendance and working hours**: Track working hours, shifts, and attendance records.
- **Employee self-service**: Employees can view payslips, apply for leave, submit reimbursements, and update personal details without HR intervention.
- **Loans and reimbursements**: Manage salary advances and expense reimbursements within the payroll cycle.
- **Salary revision approvals**: Structured workflow for salary changes with approval chains.
- **Multi-branch reporting**: Manage multiple office locations, departments, and pay schedules under one organisation.
- **Custom payslip fields**: Configurable payslip components to match any regional or organisational requirement.
- **Team status module**: Real-time visibility into team availability and escalation management (Scale plan).
- **Direct bank integration**: Disburse salaries directly to employee bank accounts (Scale plan).

## Pricing

MedleyHR is priced per organisation per month — not per employee. Each plan includes a set number of employees, with a flat add-on rate for additional headcount.

### India (INR)
- **FREE** — ₹0/month. Up to 10 employees. Core HR, payslip generation, leave management, employee self-service, and basic reports. No credit card required. Always free.
- **Growth** — ₹1,999/organisation/month (₹1,666 billed annually). 25 employees included. ₹80 per additional employee. Full payroll, compliance, attendance, loans, reimbursements, and approval workflows.
- **Scale** — ₹3,999/organisation/month (₹3,333 billed annually). 40 employees included. ₹100 per additional employee. Everything in Growth plus team status, bank integration, custom reports, and dedicated account manager.

### US / Europe (USD)
- **FREE** — $0/month. Up to 5 employees.
- **Growth** — $39/organisation/month ($33 billed annually). 10 employees included. $4 per additional employee.
- **Scale** — $49/organisation/month ($41 billed annually). 10 employees included. $5 per additional employee.

### Middle East (USD)
- **FREE** — $0/month. Up to 5 employees.
- **Growth** — $29/organisation/month ($24 billed annually). 10 employees included. $3 per additional employee.
- **Scale** — $39/organisation/month ($33 billed annually). 10 employees included. $4 per additional employee.

### Asia & Rest of World (USD)
- **FREE** — $0/month. Up to 5 employees.
- **Growth** — $19/organisation/month ($16 billed annually). 10 employees included. $2 per additional employee.
- **Scale** — $29/organisation/month ($24 billed annually). 10 employees included. $3 per additional employee.

### Africa (USD)
- **FREE** — $0/month. Up to 5 employees.
- **Growth** — $9/organisation/month ($8 billed annually). 10 employees included. $1 per additional employee.
- **Scale** — $19/organisation/month ($16 billed annually). 10 employees included. $2 per additional employee.

Annual billing saves 17% across all plans and regions. No setup fee. No implementation cost. No contracts. Cancel anytime. Pricing is shown automatically based on the visitor's location.

## Who Uses MedleyHR?

MedleyHR is built for:
- Indian SMEs and startups that have outgrown spreadsheet-based payroll
- HR managers who want to run payroll without depending on an external consultant
- Finance teams that need India-compliant statutory filings automated
- Multi-location businesses that need centralised HR across branches
- Global teams looking for affordable, self-serve HRMS with regional pricing

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can MedleyHR migrate data from another HRMS?**
Yes. Connect last month's payroll data during setup and run the next payroll without a gap. Most teams complete migration within a day.

**Is MedleyHR compliant with Indian tax laws?**
Yes. PF, ESI, TDS, PT, and Form 16 are handled out of the box and updated automatically when regulations change.

**Do I need a consultant to set up MedleyHR?**
No. MedleyHR is fully self-serve. Sign up, configure your organisation, and you are ready to run payroll. Most teams are set up within a day.

**Is payroll data secure on MedleyHR?**
Yes. 256-bit SSL encryption, role-based access controls, and regular security audits. Your data belongs to you and is never sold.

**Can MedleyHR handle multiple offices?**
Yes. Multi-branch support is available on the Growth and Scale plans, with separate departments, locations, and pay schedules under one organisation.

**Is MedleyHR available outside India?**
Yes. MedleyHR is available globally with region-specific pricing covering India, US and Europe, the Middle East, Asia and the rest of the world, and Africa. Pricing is shown automatically based on the visitor's location.

**How much does MedleyHR cost?**
MedleyHR is free for up to 10 employees in India (5 employees for other regions). Paid plans are priced per organisation per month, not per employee. In India: Growth is ₹1,999/month (25 employees included, ₹80 per additional) and Scale is ₹3,999/month (40 employees included, ₹100 per additional). Annual billing saves 17%. Pricing varies by region — see medleyhr.com for your local price.
